text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First day of summer training camp. Daitaku 
Helios got caught filling the bus's 
luggage trunk to the brim with summer hype 
goods and gave a sheepish "sowwy!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Palmer declared she was 
going to get super serious about her 
races, wanting to become someone truly 
worthy of being Daitaku Helios's bestie 
for life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios was super happy. Feeling 
mega strong, she got all fired up to win 
the Mile Championship!
